$comment: Release-wide policy the pipeline stamps into the manifest (ADR 0006). Committed so a release's
criticality is a reviewed change, not an ad-hoc button. 'critical' can also be overridden per run via
the workflow_dispatch 'critical' input; a plain tag push uses the value here.
criticality (ruling 2 / D03-2): ONLY this manifest can declare a product update critical. A
critical update locks the app until taken. Leave false unless a release genuinely must be forced.
minSupportedVersion: any install below this floor is treated as critical even when 'critical' is false
(a security floor without flagging every release). Empty = no floor.
